PLAN "12-Week Upper-Body Focused Programme for Subacromial Impingement (Pain-Free ROM)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Pain-free upper-body strength with controlled ROM avoiding overhead loading"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Assessment and foundational prep":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          external_rotation_cuff 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Stability and rotator cuff emphasis":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          external_rotation_cuff 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Glenohumeral control":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_fly 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          external_rotation_cuff 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Progress check and load reduction if needed":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_mobility 5 minutes

  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Grip, scapula, and pushes with ramped ROM":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 6.5 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 6.5 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 6.5 rest 90 seconds
          external_rotation_cuff 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Stability and control progression":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 6.5 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 6.5 rest 90 seconds
          pec_deck 3x8..12 rpe 6.5 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Low-load volume with focus on scapular control":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 6.5 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 6.5 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 6.5 rest 90 seconds
          external_rotation_cuff 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_mobility 5 minutes
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Deload and technique refinement":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 2x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 2x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5 minutes

  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Strength and ROM within pain-free limits":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          external_rotation_cuff 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Rear delt and scapular balance":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          external_rotation_cuff 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_mobility 5 minutes
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Controlled loading and symmetry":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x20 seconds rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Test and consolidate gains":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_fly 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5 minutes

SYNTAX RULES NOTES:
- Rep ranges use two dots (e.g., 8..12). Sets come first (e.g., 3x8..12).
- RPE is optional but included here for intensity guidance.
- Rest times are in seconds as specified.
- Cardio modalities used only from the allowed list; warmups/cooldowns use walking as base for practicality. If you want other modalities, substitute with closest allowed (e.g., running, cycling).
